content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Raipur SCoE4N
content_sections.text: The State Centre of Excellence for Nutrition Interventions (SCoE4N) is set up at AIIMS, Raipur, Tatibandh, GE Road, Raipur - 492 099 (CG). Its stated objective is to assist State departments in their goal of a Malnutrition free and Anemia free Chhattisgarh. It works by improving State IYCF practices and the skilled management of children with Severe Acute Malnutrition through facility and community care, including growth faltering in infants under 06 months.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, State IYCF Coordinator (Sr. No. P-01), reserved as UR. The essential qualification is any one of the following: MBBS with Public Health; BDS with Master's in Public Health; AYUSH Graduate with Master's in Public Health; a master's degree from a recognized university in one of the disciplines: Nutrition, Public Health; Health Sciences. Whichever qualification applies, the notice also asks for at least 4-5 years of progressive experience of working with government health and nutrition programs at multiple levels, of which at least 03 years at State level. The experience section asks for 4-5 years in the field of Health and Nutrition. It also asks for experience in managing a large team of support staff at the State and District level for nutrition/health programs. The notice states that preference can be given to those with experience in IYCF-related projects and programs or any government programs. The following are marked desirable or of added value: experience working at the State level in close coordination with Government Officials; previous experience with UNICEF or any other UN organization; knowledge of the local language, which is called an asset. The age limit is below 45 years as on the last date of application. The notice does not list age relaxations. It adds that eligibility criteria may be relaxed as and when required. Other requirements printed in the notice: demonstrated ability to work in a multi-disciplinary environment with governmental, non-governmental and civil society organizations; physically able to move around the project area and willing to travel to all districts of Chhattisgarh; good repute and character, without any criminal record and with no political affiliations; willingness to abide by the organization's code of conduct and child protection policy; a personal laptop or computer and expertise in Microsoft Word, Excel and Power point presentation; excellent oral and writing skills in both Hindi and English. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice gives the consolidated honorarium as Rs. 100000/- per month. The professional fees line reads "Maximum Rs. 100000/- per month (Consolidated)", and the monthly payment is negotiable based on experience, skills and industry standards. Subsistence, mobility and contingency support is provided separately for field travel. The estimated travel is a minimum of 5-7 days in a month or more as per programme requirement. The assignment is purely on contract basis from 01 January 2027 to 30 June 2027. The initial contract is issued till 30 June 2027 and may be extended based on performance, funds availability from the funding agency and continuing requirement for the position. The selected candidate completes an initial probation of 30 days from the date of joining. Leave is 7.5 days (inclusive of all leaves) over the 06 months contract on a pro-rata basis, with no leave encashment or carryover.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur State IYCF Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: The post coordinates IYCF activities with SCoE4N in coordination with NHM, DWCD, Districts, UNICEF and other line departments and stakeholders. The duties listed in Annexure I include: strengthen health facility-level interventions to promote early initiation of breastfeeding across the state, in convergence with the health department; prepare SOPs for Breastfeeding Corners, IYCF Counseling Centers, labor rooms and other health facilities; support the MAA program and the establishment of LMUs and CLMCs in the state, and a milk bank within a tertiary care facility; review the State IYCF Guideline and the IYCF training package with SIHFW, and support a pool of master trainers; facilitate IYCF training of health facility staff, MOs, ANMs/SNs and field functionaries, and set up tele-mentoring for PNC wards; conduct periodic assessments and supportive supervision visits, analyse data including Poshan Tracker, and document success stories and lessons learned; manage the project's financial activities and do any other work assigned by the Project Director or funding agency. The monthly deliverables are a Monthly Progress Report and a Field visit observation report.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Raipur State IYCF Coordinator
content_sections.text: duly filled application form (Annexure - II); one set of self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and documents; original certificates of educational qualifications, experience certificates, identity proof and other documents; two photographs; a No Objection Certificate from the present employer, for a candidate already in government service. Queries can be sent to [email protected] with the subject line "Recruitment of staff for SCoE4N".

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, and the list of shortlisted candidates will be published on the AIIMS website on 08 December 2026. Shortlisting and final selection are on merit, finalized by the selection committee, whose decision is final. If many applications are received, the interview may spill over to the next day, a screening test may be held, or another criterion may be adopted to shortlist candidates. The interview is on 15 December 2026 at Room No. 2, School of Public Health, Medical College building Gate No.5, AIIMS, Raipur, Chhattisgarh 492099. Candidates should reach the venue by 9:00 AM IST for scrutiny of documents, and registration closes at 11:00 AM IST sharp. The selected candidate is informed through mail and must join within 15 days of declaration of result. Extension of joining is considered case by case.
